title: Language and Interior
author: I. M. Dravenmoor
blurb: Edmund Thornbury, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
